title: Art Bell's satellite transmission failure during the Area 51 call
place_text: Coast to Coast AM broadcast, Nevada

tellings.quote: and the entire transmitting system by satellite went down here. And we were notified we were off the air.

plain: During a call about Area 51, the secret Air Force base in Nevada, the whole satellite system carrying Art Bell's late-night radio show Coast to Coast AM went down and the station was told it was off the air. Bell, the show's host, says so himself in a recording of the broadcast that comes up on the show with the musician Flying Lotus. The story is told because the cutoff came at the very moment someone was talking about the base's secrets.
